question: Which of the following temples is located in Uttarakhand?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neelkanth Mahadev**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Neelkanth Mahadev Temple is located in the Pauri Garhwal district of Uttarakhand.
 
• This temple is dedicated to Lord Shiva and is a significant pilgrimage site for Hindu devotees.
 
• The temple is situated at an altitude of 1330 meters and is surrounded by dense forests and mountains.
 
• Neelkanth Mahadev is named after Lord Shiva, who is also known as Neelkanth, due to the blue throat he got from consuming poison during the Samudra Manthan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ranakpur Temple**

 
 
• Ranakpur Temple is a Jain temple located in Rajasthan, India.
 
• It is one of the largest and most important temples of Jain culture.
 
• The temple is dedicated to Tirthankara Adinatha.
 
• It is known for its intricate marble architecture and over 1400 pillars, each uniquely carved.
 
 
 
• **Gomateshwara**
 
 
• Gomateshwara is a monolithic statue dedicated to the Jain deity Bahubali.
 
• It is located in Shravanabelagola, Karnataka, India.
 
• The statue is one of the largest free-standing statues in the world.
 
• Gomateshwara is an important pilgrimage site for Jains, especially during the Mahamastakabhisheka festival which is held every 12 years.
 
 
 
• **Kamakhya Temple**
 
 
• The Kamakhya Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to the mother goddess Kamakhya.
 
• It is located on the Nilachal Hill in Guwahati, Assam, India.
 
• The temple is an important pilgrimage site, particularly for Tantric worshipers.
 
• The annual Ambubachi Mela, held in June, attracts thousands of pilgrims to the Kamakhya Temple.
